Paquete de agua de emergencia

Sealed potable water container included in life-raft survival kit to supply drinking water for occupants in distress.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Paquete de agua de emergencia?

In this glossary, Paquete de agua de emergencia refers to: Sealed potable water container included in life-raft survival kit to supply drinking water for occupants in distress.

How is Paquete de agua de emergencia used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Mayday en relevo, la balsa echo informa dos paquetes de agua de emergencia rotos al embarcar; solicita lanzamiento prioritario de agua potable por aeronave SAR."

Why does Paquete de agua de emergencia matter in aviation?

Paquete de agua de emergencia matters because it supports clear communication in Cabin Safety contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses Paquete de agua de emergencia?

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Sealed potable water container included in life-raft survival kit to supply drinking water for occupants in distress.

Operational example

Mayday relay, raft echo reporting two emergency water packs ruptured during boarding; requesting priority drop of potable water by SAR aircraft.

Localized term

Paquete de agua de emergencia

Localized example

Mayday en relevo, la balsa echo informa dos paquetes de agua de emergencia rotos al embarcar; solicita lanzamiento prioritario de agua potable por aeronave SAR.
